bio: Tucked inside the historic University Arms Hotel, Parker's Tavern is a quintessentially British Brasserie and a friendly dining space where classic meets contemporary. With dark wooden interior and bookshelves adorning the walls, this stylish hideaway right in the heart of Cambridge is the perfect place to while away the afternoon.  With a classical music inspired Afternoon Tea, the menu features a delicious selection of savouries & sweets created by the pastry team. With traditional finger sandwiches and orange scones, accompanied by opera cake, white chocolate and pistachio éclair and Eton mess roulade.  Housed inside University Arms Hotel, Parker's Tavern is just a short walk from some of Cambridge's main attractions including the Church of St. Mary and the Fitzwilliam Museum.
